entities.summary: Nolly Camingue Buco is a Filipino Catholic prelate who serves as the third bishop of the Diocese of Catarman. Prior to that, he was apostolic administrator of the said diocese following the resignation of Emmanuel Trance for health reasons, while concurrently serving as the auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Antipolo.
